liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Standing on the Moon** (2 reviews): A full moon was visible during Standing on the Moon; Reviewer calls it the most heartfelt Standing on the Moon ever [14][19]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): The show opened with a crackling Jack Straw into Sugaree, per this attendee [10]
- **High Time** (1 review): The crowd sang along during High Time [10]
- **Smokestack Lightning** (1 review): During Smokestack Lightning, the reviewer expected lightning to strike someone, like a Steal Your Face logo live [14]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Terrapin Station had wonderful jamming coming out of it [19]
- **Spanish Jam** (1 review): Phil started a Rain and Snow jam lasting about a minute during the Spanish Jam as clouds rolled in [12]

## The recordings

- **gd92-05-30.sbd.kidder.8255.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 144 min; rated 4/5 by 10 [1]. Said about its sound: Track listing has first and second sets swapped, and Spanish Jam is listed twice with confusing track lengths [17]
- **gd1992-05-30.mtx.tobin.83094.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 152 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1992-05-30.150038.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 149 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1992-05-30.sbd.tobin-fixed.76082.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 152 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd92-05-30.schoeps.ladner.10063.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 156 min; rated 4.35/5 by 23 [9]. Said about its sound: Reviewer blames excess digital sounds on the soundboard for Vince's keyboard tone, citing Bob Bralove's selection of his sounds; Reviewer found keyboards weak; a friend in the parking lot could not hear any keyboard [20][21]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says they saw God in the thunderclouds that day and met Mike Steel [10]
- Sky turned nasty within about a minute as Spanish Jam got going; rain fell though the stadium was roofless, and it vanished after the show [12]
- Everyone left the stadium in silence after the show [14]
- The recording captures the audience and the drums segment reacting to a thunder, lightning and rainbow display over the desert [19]
- The following show, May 31, gets more attention, but this one had an X factor few shows have [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd92-05-30.sbd.kidder.8255.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > Lucid PCI24 > Gina 2496 > CEP > CDR [1]. Also: Soundboard to DAT, Lucid PCI24, Gina 2496, CDR, then EAC, WAV, SHN, by Charlie Kidder [1]
- **gd1992-05-30.mtx.tobin.83094.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: See info file [2]. Also: Speed-corrected, audience-patched version of the Kidder soundboard; the original ran about two seconds fast per minute; Uneven pitch drift versus the video and audience DAT suggests a cassette master may be in the soundboard's lineage [2]
- **gd1992-05-30.150038.sbd.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 4, 2020; source: SBD > DAT Master (48k) > Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [4]
- **gd1992-05-30.sbd.tobin-fixed.76082.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin;Bill Tetzeli; source: See info file [5]. Also: Kevin Tobin corrected the pitch and made patches; overlap between discs 2 and 3 was removed for seamless transition [5]
- **gd92-05-30.schoeps.ladner.10063.sbeok.shnf**: source: (FOB) Schoeps MK4 > DAT > CDR [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Fred Strame Grateful Dead: [1992-05-29 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-05-29-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-u-n-l-v-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [28]
- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1992-05-31 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-05-31-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-u-n-l-v-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [29]
- Fan art by sandcastlesandglasscamels.blogspot.com: [5-29,30, 31-92 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV](https://sandcastlesandglasscamels.blogspot.com/2010/06/5-2930-31-92-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-unlv.html) [31]
